summary: Straight-line 3DNow! transform builder. Queries a 12-byte precomputed entry through sub_5262C2 using selector a2, scales the input float a3 by 0.5 via the packed constant 0x3F0000003F000000, expands the scaled value across both lanes with PackedFloatingPointMath, then multiplies the lookup entry halves by the lane-expanded components and writes the two resulting packed values into the output __m64 pair a1[0] and a1[1].

local_names.a2: lookup selector index for the precomputed entry
local_names.a3: scalar input scaled by 0.5 before lane expansion
local_names.v3: scaled input after 0.5 multiply, held in mm0
local_names.v5: high doubleword lane of v3 expanded across both lanes
local_names.v6: combined second output half (low-lane multiply of v8 by v5, merged with v3)
local_names.v7: first half of the 12-byte lookup entry (m64 pair base)
local_names.v8: trailing scalar of the lookup entry used as an additional multiplier

operations.description: Reset MMX/3DNow state with _m_femms at function entry
sub_5262C2 fills the local lookup entry (v7 m64 pair plus trailing v8 scalar) from index a2
Scale a3 by 0.5: _m_pfmul of the converted a3 against the packed constant 0x3F0000003F000000 (0.5 in both 32-bit halves)
PackedFloatingPointMath performs component setup/expansion for the 3DNow arithmetic
Lane expansion: v5 = _m_punpckhdq(v3, v3) spreads the high lane into both lanes; v6 = _m_punpckldq(_m_pfmul(convert(v8), v5), v3) combines the trailing lookup scalar multiplied by v5 with v3
Multiply the first lookup m64 (v7) by v5 and store into the first output element a1[0]
Store the combined v6 value into the second output element a1[1]
Reset MMX/3DNow state with a trailing _m_femms before returning

clean_pseudocode: sub_5262C2(&v7, a2);   // fills 12-byte lookup entry (v7 pair + v8 scalar)
v3 = pfmul(convert_i32_to_m64(a3), 0x3F0000003F000000);  // a3 * 0.5 in both lanes
